summary: `watch remove <listing-url-or-id>` deletes a watchlist entry, backed by store.DeleteWatchlistItem(listingURL) which DELETEs by the UNIQUE listing_url and returns the rows-affected count. A full listing URL is matched verbatim; a bare id is resolved to its stored URL by scanning the watchlist for a matching listing_id, so users can remove by the same id shown in `watch list`. Removing an absent listing is a not-found (exit 3), not a silent success.
reason: The watchlist had add/list/check but no removal path, so a watched listing could never be taken off without editing the DB by hand. The delete keys on listing_url (the UNIQUE column) to hit exactly one row; the id-resolution step exists because the URL the user added and the bare room id are both natural identifiers and `watch list` surfaces the id. A regen must keep the delete method on the hand-written store/rental.go (next to the other watchlist mutators, under writeMu), not on generated store.go.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test green. Store test: seed one watchlist row, DeleteWatchlistItem returns 1 and COUNT drops to 0; deleting again returns 0 with no error. Live smoke: watch add then watch remove then watch list returned an empty watchlist.
